from __future__ import annotations

import tkinter as tk


def main() -> None:
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title('Jarvis Desktop Tool')
    root.geometry('680x420')
    label = tk.Label(root, text='Jarvis Desktop Tool Ready', font=('Segoe UI', 18))
    label.pack(pady=50)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
